parole.significato: A member of a Native American tribe of Central Canada, in the regions of Alberta, Manitoba, Northwest Territories, and…
parole.testo: From Plains Cree ᒌᐘᔮᐣ (Cīpwayān, “pointed skin”), from ᒌᐚᐤ (cīpwāw, “to be pointed”) + ᐘᔮᐣ (wayān, “skin, hide”) — a reference to the cut and style of Chipewyan parkas.
